info.name: Taf EMS API
info.description:
API requests for the Taf EMS backend.

1. Select the "Taf EMS - Local" environment.
2. Run the folders from top to bottom (or use Run collection). Login requests save the token automatically.

The collection can be run again and again: anything it changes, it changes back.
